reply.text:
Burnout is worth taking seriously, so let me look at how your training has actually been going before I say what to change. Nothing is logged for the last eight weeks, and there's no active program on record. So I can't see a volume spike or a stall behind this feeling, and I won't guess at one.

Burnout on lifting usually comes from one of three things: the same routine for too long, too many hard weeks with no lighter one, or lifting with no clear target. Which of those sounds closest to you? If you tell me what you've been doing and how often, I can point you in a direction.

If you do want a change, I'll build it for you. Tell me the goal and how many days a week you can train, and the Build it button will put a new block together. Until then, a week of lighter loads or a different kind of session like a long walk or a bike ride is a reasonable way to reset without losing ground.
